## What CSI does
CSI is a mobile specialty cleanup company. Core services are crime scene cleanup, trauma and biohazard cleanup, blood and bodily-fluid cleanup, homicide cleanup, suicide cleanup, unattended death cleanup, decomposition cleanup, hazardous hoarding cleanup, forensic odor removal, vehicle biohazard cleanup and extreme specialty cleanup.

CSI should not be described as a routine housekeeping, ordinary commercial janitorial, move-in/move-out, post-construction or vehicle-detailing company.

For immediate danger or an active/unreleased crime scene, contact emergency services and do not disturb the scene. CSI cleanup begins after appropriate scene release.

## Geographic service hierarchy
Primary home market: Dallas-Fort Worth (DFW) Metroplex and North Texas.
Core local markets include Dallas, Fort Worth, Denton, Plano, Frisco, Arlington, Irving, McKinney, Keller, Southlake, Lewisville and Flower Mound.
Denton County is a primary local authority market. Qualifying statewide Texas response is secondary and does not imply separate offices or storefronts.
